Tropical Storm "Queenie"

Tropical Cyclone: ALERT -->

Issued at 11:00 am, 24 September 2026
(Valid for broadcast until the next advisory to be issued at 5:00 PM today) -->
(Valid for broadcast until the next advisory to be issued at 5:00 PM today)

TROPICAL STORM SURIGAE HAS ENTERED THE PHILIPPINE AREA OF RESPONSIBILITY AND WAS GIVEN THE LOCAL NAME “QUEENIE”

HAZARDS AFFECTING LAND AREAS
Severe Winds
The periphery and trough of QUEENIE will bring strong to gale-force gusts over the following areas (especially in coastal and upland areas exposed to winds):
Today (24 September): Batanes, Babuyan Islands, and Ilocos Norte.
Tomorrow (25 September) until Saturday (26 September): Davao Oriental, Davao Occidental, and Sarangani.
HAZARDS AFFECTING COASTAL WATERS
24-Hour Sea Condition Outlook
Coastal waters have forecast wave heights of less than 2.0 m.
TRACK AND INTENSITY OUTLOOK
It must be emphasized that heavy rainfall and severe winds may still be experienced in localities outside the landfall point and the forecast confidence cone. Refer to “Other Hazards affecting Land Areas” for more details. Furthermore, the track may still shift within the limit of the forecast confidence cone.
Tropical Storm QUEENIE will generally move west northwestward until Friday (25 September) before turning north northeastward by Monday (28 September) and will exit the Philippine Area of Responsibility (PAR) by Tuesday (29 September) morning.
This tropical cyclone will gradually intensify while inside the PAR. It may reach typhoon category by Sunday (27 September).

Location of Eye/center

The center of Tropical Storm QUEENIE was estimated based on all available data at 1,310 km East of Northern Luzon (17.8 °N, 134.1 °E )

Movement

Moving West Northwestward at 35 km/h

Strength

Maximum sustained winds of 75 km/h near the center and gustiness of up to 90 km/h

Forecast Position

Sep 25, 2026 08:00 PM - 705 km East of Basco, Batanes

Sep 26, 2026 08:00 AM - 580 km East of Basco, Batanes

Sep 26, 2026 08:00 PM - 520 km East Northeast of Itbayat, Batanes

Sep 27, 2026 08:00 AM - 530 km East Northeast of Itbayat, Batanes

Sep 28, 2026 08:00 AM - 630 km Northeast of Itbayat, Batanes

Sep 29, 2026 08:00 AM - 790 km Northeast of Itbayat, Batanes (OUTSIDE PAR)

Wind Signal

No Tropical Cyclone Wind Signal

Considering these developments, the public and disaster risk reduction and management offices concerned are advised to take all necessary measures to protect life and property. Persons living in areas identified to be highly or very highly susceptible to these hazards are advised to follow evacuation and other instructions from local officials. For heavy rainfall warnings, thunderstorm/rainfall advisories, and other severe weather information specific to your area, please monitor products issued by your local PAGASA Regional Services Division.
